mapper.select: select a.* from (select cert.*, CASE WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY < DATE(NOW()) then '已过期' WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) then '临近一个月' WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) then '临近六个月' ELSE '' END AS certStage from BIZ_ZIZHI_CERTIFICATE cert where cert.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE') a ${ew.customSqlSegment}
